newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso closes 20 centavos up on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso closes 20 centavos up on dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended 20 centavos up at 1,098.3 against the dollar Friday in quiet trading, interbank traders said.
"The market was quiet, there was little supply and demand. There was speculation that the peso rate would rise to 1,096 by the end of the week, but that didn't happen," one trader said.
The peso opened at 1,098.3, hit an intraday high of 1,097 and sank to a low of 1,099.2.
Dealers reported 276 trades worth a total of $134 million, below the daily average of about $180 million.
